answer.summary: All 10 failing tests are Spring context load failures, not flaky tests. The cause is a NoSuchMethodError for DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder(MeterRegistry) inside MetricsAutoConfiguration, which means the classpath has incompatible Spring Boot 4 and Micrometer versions. The change bumps spring-boot-starter-parent to 4.x in pom.xml, so the failure is deterministic and a re-run will repeat it.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
